context: M23 o5. Hanyang House, the back room. Mi-sook unlocks a steel cabinet behind the kimchi crocks.

lines.speaker: char.mi_sook_baek
lines.text: Kye is twelve families, one pot. Same as your friend's club, Miss Moore.

lines.speaker: char.mi_sook_baek
lines.text: Your money sleeps next to ours. Nobody robs twelve Korean grandmothers.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Rule thirteen: trust a woman who counts faster than you.

lines.speaker: char.mi_sook_baek
lines.text: There's no thirteen. You made it up just now. I like it.
